name: Movistar Madrid Half Marathon

trackSource.notes: GPX "Movistar MMM25" (track "MMMM2025  ACTUALIZADA paso Centro") linked as "Track del recorrido (.GPX)" on the official course page on 2026-11-27. It is the 2025 track (an earlier one): it measures 21.447 km, the same as the route carried into the 2027 edition, and the existing points fit it.

notes: The 2026 edition was in March; the announced 2027 date is in April. On 2026-11-27 the 2027 regulations also gave a 9:10 wheelchair start, in a sentence that does not name the edition; wave times were not published.
